description: This file declares the ModelRunnerHandle class which encapsulates a handle for running models in Torch's native runtime. It includes constructors, a destructor, methods to execute models with inputs, and manages a private pointer to an implementation class.

classes.name: ModelRunnerHandle
classes.description: A handle class for executing models, managing a private implementation, and providing run interfaces for model inference.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handle with a package path and model name.

methods.description: Method to execute the model with a list of arguments and named keyword arguments.

methods.description: Low-level API for executing the model with flattened input data, expecting ownership transfer.
